emma_support: FYI escalation from AcmePay (CS-9381) — multiple customers reporting SSE streams cutting out mid-response when switching from cellular -> wifi, or when phone briefly loses signal. Partial chunks arrive, then connection closes. Repro steps below.

jason_eng: Can you drop logs and a repro curl? Also how long into the stream does it usually die?

emma_support: Usually 10-30s after start. Customer reports partial JSON chunks and then client-side error: "net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET" or socket closed. Attached server snippet:

emma_support: ```
[2026-03-10T14:12:02Z] stream_start user_id=acme_user_42 req_id=req_0x9f
[2026-03-10T14:12:18Z] chunk_sent size=234 req_id=req_0x9f
[2026-03-10T14:12:23Z] client_disconnect code=ECONNRESET remote_ip=10.45.32.9 req_id=req_0x9f
```

miguel_mobile: Sounds like a mobile NAT or carrier TCP reset when radio switches. On iOS/Android the socket often resets on network change. Does the client implement SSE re-subscribe with Last-Event-ID?

emma_support: Customer client is a webview in their hybrid app, no Last-Event-ID handling. They just open EventSource and rely on browser.

jason_eng: Two angles: server keepalive + explicit SSE hints. If proxies or carrier drop idle TCP, sending a comment line `: keepalive\n\n` every 15s usually keeps NATs alive. Also add `retry: 3000` so client tries to reconnect faster with backoff.

lewis_sre: Also check our proxy timeouts (fastly/nginx). If proxy_read_timeout < 60s it can tear streams. On the Dedicated stack we default to 90s but some fronting proxies/regional CDNs may have lower.

emma_support: Repro curl we asked the customer to run:

emma_support: ```bash
curl -N -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  "https://api.redwood.sh/v1/streams/generate?model=redwood-1&prompt=hello"
```

jason_eng: Helpful. If you can reproduce locally, try running tcpdump to see if an RST is coming from the client side or an intermediate. Example: `sudo tcpdump -i any tcp and port 443 and host <client_ip>` while reproing.

miguel_mobile: On Android the webview sometimes closes idle sockets aggressively in background; on iOS switching from 5G->WiFi the kernel will teardown and apps should recreate EventSource. For immediate mitigation advise customer to implement `onerror` handler that calls `es.close(); es = new EventSource(url);` and use Last-Event-ID header to resume.

emma_support: Customer asked if Redwood can keep the stream resumable. We currently support Last-Event-ID in the API for incremental outputs if the client sends `Last-Event-ID` — but we need to confirm server retention window.

jason_eng: Server supports Last-Event-ID for up to 2 minutes of KV cache retention for short sessions; beyond that the runtime may evict. We can extend retention per-customer but that's an ops change. Short-term fix: server-side keepalive and adding a small JSON chunk flush every 8-12s to prevent proxies dropping.

lewis_sre: Ops note: potential mitigation we can push: emit SSE comment heartbeat every 12s and tune `proxy_read_timeout` for the affected region to 120s. I'll open an infra ticket.

emma_support: Suggested message to customer (short):

emma_support: "We recommend adding an SSE reconnect strategy (handle onerror + re-create EventSource, include Last-Event-ID) and we will enable keepalive heartbeats on your stream and request a regional proxy timeout increase. Can you confirm you can add a Last-Event-ID/offset on your side?"

jason_eng: Quick code snippets to share with them: client reconnection + Last-Event-ID sample:```js
let es = new EventSource(url);
es.onmessage = (e) => { /* apply chunk */ lastId = e.lastEventId || lastId; }
es.onerror = () => { es.close(); setTimeout(() => { es = new EventSource(url + (lastId? `&last_event_id=${lastId}` : '')); }, 1500); };
```

miguel_mobile: Server-side keepalive example for Node/Express endpoint:```js
res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream');
res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache');
res.write(': heartbeat\n\n');
const t = setInterval(() => { res.write(': heartbeat\n\n'); }, 12000);
// write chunks as normal, clearInterval on finish/error
```

emma_support: Customer also reported some 502s during the flips. Could be proxy returning 502 when backend connection resets.

lewis_sre: I'll correlate with Fastly/CF logs for the customer's region/time window. If we see proxy 502s matching our stream resets, we push the keepalive and timeout change.

emma_support: Next steps: 1) Send reconnection + Last-Event-ID guidance to customer (I will). 2) Lewis will open infra ticket to enable 12s keepalive gating + request proxy timeout bump for the region. 3) Jason to confirm server-side retention window and whether we can extend for CS-9381.

jason_eng: I can extend retention for that customer to 5m as a targeted rollback while we evaluate cost. Will coordinate with ops.

deploy-bot: [deploy] keepalive-heartbeat:canary deployed to staging at 2026-03-11T03:40:12Z :rocket:

emma_support: Thanks all — I'll update the customer with the immediate client changes and let them know we're enabling server keepalives and extending retention as a temporary measure. :thumbsup:

lewis_sre: Filed INFRA-4721 to change proxy timeout + enable per-customer keepalive gating.

emma_support: Closing internal thread, will reopen if customer still sees midstream disconnects after these changes."
